title: These Items Should Never Be Flushed!
description:
Toilets aren't trash cans. Remember: if it doesn't come from you, it doesn't belong in the loo.

Items like wipes, trash and grease clog wet wells and pump stations, leading to backups that can stop you from doing tasks inside your home like showering or doing dishes. 

Protect your home and our sewer system! More information: sandiego.gov/public-utilities/customer-support/do-not-flush
